name: Film noir
garments: not primarily a fashion look — a cinematography style

media.title: critic Nino Frank coined "film noir" in a 1946 essay

reacts_against: classical Hollywood's bright, evenly lit studio glamour, using hard shadow and venetian-blind lighting to visualize moral ambiguity instead.
revivals: directly cited as neon-noir and cyberpunk's shared visual ancestor

findings: dark — about 58% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 100% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
